name: paper-collage
description: 剪纸拼贴风·真纸资产版:实拍卡纸标题条/面板(微信CDN)+ 马克笔垫色 + 撕纸分隔。配 paper-collage 工作流使用。
container_style: max-width:677px; margin:0 auto; padding:20px 14px; background:#EAE2D5; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Helvetica Neue','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;

tags.h1: display:inline-block; background-image:url({{asset:bar-ink}}); background-size:100% 100%; color:#F5EFE2; font-size:19px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:3px; line-height:1.5; padding:12px 24px; margin:36px 0 18px; transform:rotate(-1deg);
tags.h2: display:inline-block; background-image:url({{asset:bar-ink}}); background-size:100% 100%; color:#F5EFE2; font-size:17px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:3px; line-height:1.5; padding:11px 22px; margin:36px 0 16px; transform:rotate(-1deg);
tags.h3: display:inline-block; background-image:url({{asset:bar-cream}}); background-size:100% 100%; color:#201C18; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.5; padding:9px 18px; margin:28px 0 14px; transform:rotate(0.5deg);
tags.p: font-size:15px; line-height:1.9; color:#3E362C; margin:16px 0; letter-spacing:0.3px; text-align:justify; word-break:break-word;
tags.blockquote: background-image:url({{asset:panel-cream}}); background-size:100% 100%; border:none; padding:26px 26px; margin:26px 6px; color:#5C5344; font-size:15px; line-height:1.85; transform:rotate(-0.5deg);
tags.code: background:#EDE4D3; color:#8A4B2E; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:3px; font-size:13px; font-family:Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
tags.pre: background:#201C18; color:#F0E9DB; padding:16px; overflow-x:auto; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; box-shadow:3px 5px 12px rgba(50,43,32,0.25);
